title: neuradex chart values
description: Values for the neuradex Helm chart. Mirrors the inline documentation in values.yaml.

nameOverride.description: Partially override generated resource names (replaces the chart-name part only).

fullnameOverride.description: Fully override all generated resource names.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for pulling the image from a private registry.

name.description: Name of the image pull secret.

replicaCount.description: Desired number of replicas. The service is stateless and safe to scale.

containerPort.description: Port the service binds to inside the container (LISTEN_ADDR=0.0.0.0:<containerPort>); the Service and probes target this port via the `http` named port.

tag.description: Image tag; falls back to the chart's appVersion when empty.

digest.description: Optional immutable digest pin ("sha256:..."); takes precedence over image.tag.

pullPolicy.description: Pull policy. Never is useful with kind clusters fed via kind load docker-image.

create.description: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount; no API token is ever mounted.

name.description: ServiceAccount name; defaults to the release fullname when created, `default` otherwise.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing secret holding KAGI_SESSION_TOKEN. When set, kagiSessionToken is ignored and no Secret is created.

kagiSessionTokenKey.description: Key within the secret holding the token.

kagiSessionToken.description: Token value; only used when existingSecret is empty (the chart then creates the Secret). Prefer existingSecret in production.

audit.description: Audit event output and the HMAC key used to hash identifiers and IP addresses.

logPath.description: JSONL audit log path. Empty writes audit events to stdout (the service also treats `-` as stdout). A file path needs a writable volume via extraVolumes/extraVolumeMounts because the root filesystem is read-only; its parent directory must exist.

hmacKey.description: HMAC key used to hash identifiers and IP addresses in audit headers. Dev-only plaintext: when set and audit.existingSecret is empty the chart creates a Secret. Prefer audit.existingSecret in production.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing secret holding the audit HMAC key. When set, audit.hmacKey must be empty and no Secret is created.

hmacKeyKey.description: Key within the secret holding the HMAC key.

port.description: Port exposed by the Service (targetPort is the http named port).

userAgent.description: Optional USER_AGENT override for the browser-impersonating HTTP client; empty uses the application default.

privacyPass.description: Use anonymous Privacy Pass tokens for searches. Disable to fall back to session-cookie search authentication; the session token is required for issuance either way.

kagiMaxSessions.description: Maximum number of simultaneous searches (1 through 64). Bounds concurrency in both authentication modes (Privacy Pass and session cookie); additional requests queue until a slot frees up.

rustLog.description: RUST_LOG value consumed by the tracing EnvFilter (e.g. `info`, `neuradex=debug,hyper=warn`).

logFormat.description: Log line format. JSON is recommended for structured log pipelines.

otelExporterOtlpEndpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP endpoint for traces and logs. Empty disables export. The default NetworkPolicy only allows egress on ports 80/443 (plus DNS); allow the collector's port with extraNetworkPolicyEgress.

content.description: Content plane capture store and packing policy.

store.description: Content backend: off disables capture; local writes packs under a directory; s3 writes them to an S3-compatible bucket.

path.description: Root directory for the local content store, mounted from the configured volume. It must be writable because the container root filesystem is read-only.

persistence.description: PersistentVolumeClaim settings for the local content store. When disabled an emptyDir is used and captured content is ephemeral.

enabled.description: Create/use a PersistentVolumeClaim for the local content store. When false an emptyDir is mounted instead and captured content is lost on pod restart or rescheduling.

existingClaim.description: Use an existing PersistentVolumeClaim instead of creating one. Requires persistence.enabled=true.

size.description: Requested size of the chart-managed PersistentVolumeClaim.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the chart-managed PersistentVolumeClaim. Empty uses the cluster default StorageClass.

accessModes.description: Access modes for the chart-managed PersistentVolumeClaim.

endpoint.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL, for example https://s3.us-west-004.backblazeb2.com. Required when content.store=s3.

region.description: Signing region sent to the S3 endpoint. Required when content.store=s3.

bucket.description: Bucket holding content packs. Required when content.store=s3.

prefix.description: Optional key prefix inside the bucket. Empty stores objects at the bucket root and CONTENT_S3_PREFIX is not set.

forcePathStyle.description: Use path-style addressing (endpoint/bucket/key) instead of virtual-hosted-style addressing. Required by most S3-compatible services.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing secret holding the S3 credentials. When set, the inline credentials must be empty and no Secret is created.

accessKeyIdKey.description: Key within the secret holding the S3 access key identifier.

secretAccessKeyKey.description: Key within the secret holding the S3 secret access key.

accessKeyId.description: S3 access key identifier. Dev-only plaintext: when both inline credentials are set and existingSecret is empty the chart creates a Secret. Prefer existingSecret in production.

secretAccessKey.description: S3 secret access key. Dev-only plaintext: when both inline credentials are set and existingSecret is empty the chart creates a Secret. Prefer existingSecret in production.

packTargetBytes.description: Target size of a content pack before it is sealed.

maxPackAgeSecs.description: Maximum age in seconds of an open content pack before it is sealed.

maxBodyBytes.description: Maximum response body size captured into content packs.

compressionLevel.description: Zstd compression level for content packs (1 through 22; higher is slower and smaller).

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations on the Deployment's pod template.

podLabels.description: Extra labels on the Deployment's pod template.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level securityContext. Secure defaults match the distroless nonroot image (uid/gid 65532, RuntimeDefault seccomp).

containerSecurityContext.description: Container-level securityContext (no privilege escalation, capabilities dropped, read-only root filesystem).

resources.description: Resource requests/limits. The CPU limit is intentionally unset to avoid throttling.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe (full Kubernetes probe spec); defaults to GET /healthz on the http named port.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe (full Kubernetes probe spec); defaults to GET /healthz on the http named port.

enabled.description: Enable the default-deny style NetworkPolicy (ingress to containerPort; egress to DNS plus 80/443).
Enable an Ingress fronting the Service.

annotations.description: Extra annotations for the Ingress resource.

hpa.description: HorizontalPodAutoscaler (autoscaling/v2); when enabled, minReplicas overrides replicaCount.

pdb.description: PodDisruptionBudget; with a single replica, enabling this blocks all voluntary evictions.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints; a soft spread over kubernetes.io/hostname is recommended with replicaCount >= 2.

extraEnv.description: Additional env entries merged into the container environment (name/value or valueFrom).

extraNetworkPolicyEgress.description: Extra egress rules appended to the NetworkPolicy (standard NetworkPolicyEgressRule objects, e.g. an OTLP collector on port 4318). Without a rule, egress is limited to DNS (53) and ports 80/443.

resourceList.description: Kubernetes resource quantity map (e.g. cpu: 50m, memory: 64Mi).
